PM-Kisan SMS shows '1 paisa' to Maharashtra farmer, causes confusion

A farmer in Maharashtra reportedly received an SMS indicating a payment of only one paisa under the PM-Kisan scheme, instead of the expected ₹2,000 installment. The incident has caused confusion among beneficiaries. Outlets suggest this may be due to a technical glitch.
